verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs list current-generation B200, H100 and GH200 on-demand instance types, and its pricing page offers self-serve B200, H100, A100 and GH200 instances, so A100 serves as a previous-generation option alongside current-gen GPUs. A community user also actually launched a GH200 instance. Missing for 10: no evidence of H200 availability, no documented price comparison showing the previous-generation tier is cheaper, and no evidence of a broader older-GPU lineup beyond A100.
